t: Varta Longlife Power AAA alkaline battery pack delivers reliable energy to site essentials and everyday devices. Suitable for torches, flashlights, lanterns, clocks and radios. Leakproof design helps to protects equipment from damage, whilst the alkaline chemistry handles energy-intensive devices without dropping power prematurely. Each battery can be stored for up to 10 years. Convenient packaging ensures easy storage and quick access when batteries fail.
